arguments.name: rollback

arguments.description: release operation ID whose retained data is removed
arguments.name: finalize

operations.description: Use to move one application to another admitted release. Stops it and checkpoints its data for rollback; the next apply starts the new release and finalize drops the checkpoint.

arguments.description: release operation ID

operations.description: Use to see where an application release change stands. Reads the Owner-signed record, the retained volumes and their read-back; changes nothing.
operations.title: Application release status

operations.description: Use before adding or removing a household member. Lists household users in local PocketID; reads only.
operations.title: List users

operations.description: Use when the owner cannot sign in. Reads the owner passkey activation status without its activation link; changes nothing.
operations.title: Owner activation status

arguments.description: household username
arguments.name: username

operations.description: Use to remove a household member for good. Revokes their devices and sessions and deletes the PocketID user; the owner and admins are refused.
operations.title: Remove user

operations.description: Use to check the spec and kit definitions before planning. Reads and validates only; changes no lifecycle state.
operations.title: Validate

operations.description: Use after stackkit_apply, or when something looks wrong. Runs read-only checks across desired, planned, applied and observed state.
operations.title: Verify
